; herdRespond: a RESPOND button on a "To NAME" notebook (OS 3.29).
; Live mode reads the visible framebuffer and inserts the reply through xochitl's native text editor.
; The notebook stays open throughout; xochitl saves its own document normally.
; The legacy disk-write branch is retained for older non-live jobs.
; Install with notebook_client.py deploy-tablet (private auth provisioning), then restart xochitl after saving notes.
; Do not upload this raw template: the private tablet capability is filled only during deployment.

AFFECT /qml/device/view/navigator/Navigator.qml
	TRAVERSE FocusScope
		LOCATE BEFORE ALL
		INSERT {
			property var herdJob: null
			property string herdState: ""     // "", saving, sending, waiting, ready, writing, or a failure to show
			property string herdNote: ""
			property string herdAuth: "__HERD_TABLET_AUTH__" // Filled only in private tablet deployment.
			function herdHttp(method, path, obj, done) {
				var x = new XMLHttpRequest()
				x.onreadystatechange = function() {
					if (x.readyState !== XMLHttpRequest.DONE) return
					var r = null
					try { r = JSON.parse(x.responseText) } catch (e) {}
					done(x.status, r)
				}
				x.open(method, "http://127.0.0.1:8791" + path)
				x.setRequestHeader("Content-Type", "application/json")
				x.setRequestHeader("Authorization", "Bearer " + herdAuth)
				x.send(obj ? JSON.stringify(obj) : null)
			}
			function herdUuid(v) { return String(v || "").replace(/[{}]/g, "") }
			function herdReopen(j) {
				var e = Library.entryForId(j.doc)
				if (e) requestOpenDocumentOnPage(e, j.idx)
			}
			function herdFail(st, r) {
				console.warn("herdRespond: failure " + st + " " + (r && r.error ? r.error : "connection unavailable"))
				var stopped = herdState === "writing" && herdJob && herdJob.live && herdJob.path && herdJob.request ? herdJob : null
				herdState = "failed"; herdNote = herdFailureNote(r, st)
				if (stopped) {
					// Status only: never retry, clear an attempt, or transmit free-form diagnostics.
					herdHttp("POST", "/native-text-failed", {page: stopped.path, request: stopped.request}, function() {})
				}
				if (herdJob && herdJob.path && herdJob.request) { herdTimer.interval = 2000; herdTimer.restart() }
			}
			function herdDismissFailure() {
				// Dismissal is not a resend. The next explicit RESPOND starts a new job.
				herdTimer.stop(); herdState = ""; herdNote = ""; herdJob = null
			}
			function herdFailureNote(reply, status) {
				// Fixed presentation vocabulary only. Neither provider diagnostics
				// nor arbitrary server text/paths are displayed on the notebook.
				var error = reply && typeof reply.error === "string" ? reply.error : ""
				var notes = ["Agent timed out", "Agent is busy", "Agent connection failed", "Agent service failed",
					"Reply format wasn't supported", "Agent reply was cut short", "Request stopped",
					"Page changed — request stopped", "Page unavailable — request stopped",
					"Previous reply is still pending", "Reply couldn't be placed", "Reply may be incomplete",
					"Mac connection lost", "Notebook connection needs setup", "Notebook service unavailable",
					"No new handwriting found", "Reply needs attention"]
				if (notes.indexOf(error) >= 0) return error
				if (status === 401 || status === 403) return "Notebook connection needs setup"
				if (status === 503) return "Notebook service unavailable"
				if (!error && status === 0) return "Mac connection lost"
				if (error === "Notebook model page_changed; request stopped before insertion; no automatic resend") return "Page changed — request stopped"
				if (error === "Notebook model page_unavailable; request stopped before insertion; no automatic resend") return "Page unavailable — request stopped"
				var match = /^Notebook model ([a-z_]+); reply held, no automatic resend$/.exec(error)
				if (match) {
					var code = match[1]
					if (code === "deadline") return "Agent timed out"
					if (code === "busy") return "Agent is busy"
					if (code === "closed" || code === "unavailable") return "Agent connection failed"
					if (code === "provider_error") return "Agent service failed"
					if (code === "incomplete_response") return "Agent reply was cut short"
					if (code === "cancelled") return "Request stopped"
					if (["invalid_json", "invalid_response", "reply_too_large", "model_mismatch", "tools_forbidden"].indexOf(code) >= 0) return "Reply format wasn't supported"
				}
				if (error === "A notebook request is already pending on this page") return "Previous reply is still pending"
				if (error === "unsupported native text anchor") return "Reply couldn't be placed"
				if (error === "nothing new written since the last answer") return "No new handwriting found"
				if (error.indexOf("Caption incomplete:") === 0 || error === "Tablet stopped while inserting this reply; inspect the page before retrying") return "Reply may be incomplete"
				return "Reply needs attention"
			}
			// the DocumentView has just closed its notebook (saving the page): send it, and reopen
			function herdRespond(doc, idx, page, supersedes) {
				herdJob = { doc: herdUuid(doc), idx: idx, page: herdUuid(page), path: "", live: true, supersedes: supersedes || "" }
				herdState = "saving"; herdNote = ""
				herdTimer.interval = 1; herdTimer.restart()
			}
			// the answer is ready and the notebook has closed again: write it in, and reopen
			function herdWrite() {
				herdState = "writing"
				herdTimer.interval = herdJob && herdJob.live ? 1 : 1500; herdTimer.restart()
			}
			function herdStep() {
				var j = herdJob
				if (!j) { herdTimer.stop(); return }
				if (herdState === "saving") {
					herdState = "sending"; herdTimer.stop()
					herdHttp("POST", "/respond", { doc: j.doc, page: j.page, live: j.live === true, supersedes: j.supersedes || "" }, function(st, r) {
						if (st === 200) { j.path = r.page; j.request = r.request; herdState = "waiting"; herdNote = "Sent to " + r.to
							herdTimer.interval = 250; herdTimer.restart() }
						else herdFail(st, r)
						if (!j.live) herdReopen(j)
					})
				} else if (herdState === "failed") {
					if (!j.path || !j.request) { herdTimer.stop(); return }
					herdHttp("GET", "/answer?page=" + encodeURIComponent(j.path), null, function(st, r) {
						// A late save acknowledgement may clear ONLY this request's error.
						// Never auto-write a failed/partially inserted reply again.
						if (herdJob !== j || herdState !== "failed" || st !== 200 || !r) return
						if (r.request === j.request && r.state === "written") herdDismissFailure()
						else if (r.request === j.request && r.state === "ready" && r.retry_token && r.retry_token !== j.lastRetry) {
							// Explicit server preflight proved this request never began insertion.
							j.lastRetry = r.retry_token; herdTimer.stop(); herdState = "ready"
						}
					})
				} else if (herdState === "waiting") {
					herdHttp("GET", "/answer?page=" + encodeURIComponent(j.path), null, function(st, r) {
						// A late/overlapping poll cannot start another insertion or
						// apply an old request's state to a newer notebook exchange.
						if (st !== 200 || !r || herdJob !== j || herdState !== "waiting" || r.request !== j.request) return
						if (r.state === "ready") { herdTimer.stop(); herdState = "ready" }   // ready starts the write: stop the poll first
						else if (r.state === "waiting" && r.media_pending) herdNote = "Generating image…"
						else if (r.state === "failed" || r.state === "no answer") { herdState = "failed"; herdNote = herdFailureNote(r); herdTimer.stop() }
					})
				} else if (herdState === "writing") {
					herdTimer.stop()
					herdHttp("POST", j.live ? "/write-live" : "/write", { page: j.path }, function(st, r) {
						if (st === 200) { if (r && typeof r.idx === "number" && r.idx >= 0) j.idx = r.idx; herdState = ""; herdNote = ""; herdJob = null }
						else herdFail(st, r)
						if (!j.live) herdReopen(j)
					})
				}
			}
			Timer { id: herdTimer; repeat: true; onTriggered: herdStep() }
			onHerdStateChanged: console.warn("herdRespond: state -> " + herdState + " " + herdNote)
		}
	END TRAVERSE
END AFFECT

AFFECT /qml/device/view/documentview/DocumentView.qml
	TRAVERSE FocusScope#root
		LOCATE AFTER ALL
		INSERT {
			Rectangle {
				id: herdButton
				property string herdTitle: sceneView.document ? String(sceneView.document.visibleName || sceneView.document.title || "") : ""
				property bool herdMine: navigator.herdJob !== null && sceneView.document && navigator.herdJob.doc === navigator.herdUuid(sceneView.document.id)
				property string herdPage: navigator.herdUuid(root.currentPageId)
				property string herdFollowedPage: ""
				property int herdOpenPasses: 0
				property string herdResumeCheckedPage: ""
				property string herdIncompleteRequest: ""
				property string herdIncompletePage: ""
				property string herdIncompleteDismissed: ""
				property bool herdResumeInFlight: false
				property string herdContextSurface: String(Date.now()) + "-" + String(Math.floor(Math.random() * 1000000000))
				property int herdContextSequence: 0
				property int herdContextRevision: 0
				property int herdContextInk: 0
				property bool herdContextBusy: false
				property string herdContextRepairSeen: ""
				property string herdContextLayoutSignature: ""
				property string herdAuditSeen: ""
				property double herdAwakeUntil: 0
				property bool herdAwakeActive: false
				onHerdAwakeActiveChanged: herdSetDisplayAwake(herdAwakeActive)
				function herdSetDisplayAwake(active) {

					if (typeof BatteryManager.onActivity !== "function") {

				property var herdProbeJob: null
				property var herdProbeView: null
				property string herdProbeSeen: ""
				property int herdProbePasses: 0
				property string herdProbePhase: ""
				property int herdProbeSelected: 0
				property int herdProbeCloned: 0
				property bool herdProbeCloneValue: false
				property bool herdProbeHasLength: false
				property string herdProbeReason: "none"
				property var herdProbeItems: null
				property var herdProbeTextAnchor: null
				property var herdProbeTextBounds: null
				property var herdProbeInkBounds: null
				property bool herdPasteBusy: false
				property var herdLayoutCapture: null
				property bool herdLayoutPenBlocked: false

					var found = null

					// null handler while adjustViewActive also changes its native route.

					target: herdButton.herdPenSurface

				}
				property var herdPasteController: null
				property int herdPasteLockPasses: 0
				property var herdInk: null
				property var herdProbeImportCallback: null
				property string herdProbeImportDoc: ""
				property string herdProbeImportPage: ""
				property var herdLessonImport: null

				// preview. An automatic ink paste needs the preview, not editing
				// chrome. Keep the handler/selection/commit and input lock intact.
				function herdQuietInkSelection() {
					var selection = sceneView.selectionHandler
					if (herdInk && herdInk.ownsLock && herdPasteBusy && selection && selection.controlsAreVisible)

				}
				Connections {
					target: sceneView.selectionHandler
					function onControlsAreVisibleChanged() { herdButton.herdQuietInkSelection() }
				}
				Connections {
					target: sceneView
					function onSelectionHandlerChanged() { herdButton.herdQuietInkSelection() }
				}
				Binding {
					target: root; property: "enabled"; value: false
					when: herdButton.herdPasteBusy
					restoreMode: Binding.RestoreBindingOrValue
				}
				Binding {
					target: sceneView; property: "adjustViewActive"; value: true
					when: herdButton.herdPasteBusy
					restoreMode: Binding.RestoreBindingOrValue
				}
				Binding {
					target: sceneView.strokeHandler; property: "lineTool"; value: Line.SelectionTool
					when: herdButton.herdPasteBusy
					restoreMode: Binding.RestoreBindingOrValue
				}

					id: herdAssetScene
					SceneView {
						width: 1404; height: 1872
						viewportType: SceneView.DeviceViewport

				anchors.right: parent.right
				anchors.top: parent.top
				anchors.rightMargin: 40
				anchors.topMargin: 112
				z: 100000
				width: Math.min(660, herdLabel.implicitWidth + 56)
				height: Math.max(84, herdLabel.implicitHeight + 32)
				radius: 8
				color: herdMine && navigator.herdState !== "failed" ? "white" : "black"
				border.color: "black"
				border.width: 3
				function herdStatusLabel() {

					if (!herdMine) return herdNewQuestionRequest() ? "New question — keep previous reply" : "RESPOND"
					var s = navigator.herdState, j = navigator.herdJob

						if (note === "Agent timed out" || note === "Agent is busy") return note + "\nDismiss, then Respond to retry"
						if (note === "Mac connection lost") return note + "\nCheck Mac and Wi-Fi; tap to dismiss"
						if (note === "Previous reply is still pending" || note === "Reply couldn't be placed") return note + "\nReply held; tap to dismiss"
						if (note === "Reply may be incomplete") return note + "\nInspect the page; tap to dismiss"
						return note + "\nTap to dismiss"

				function herdDismissIncomplete() {
					if (herdIncompletePage !== herdPage || !herdIncompleteRequest) return false
					herdIncompleteDismissed = herdIncompleteRequest
					herdIncompleteRequest = ""
					return true // Presentation only: no insertion, retry or journal changes.
				}
				function herdNewQuestionRequest() {
					return herdIncompletePage === herdPage ? herdIncompleteDismissed : ""
				}

					// Isolated trial of the same native hint used by OS 3.29 Page
					// Overview. This is NOT a save-complete acknowledgement: all
					// server snapshot/revision/preservation checks still apply.
					if (!sceneView.document || navigator.herdUuid(sceneView.document.id) !== "905df7ae-ff54-46b9-a71e-45bb02bef638" ||
						!herdPage || root.inSuspend || sceneView.isLoading || navigator.herdJob) return false

					if (!c || typeof c.requestDeferredCompleted !== "function") return false
					try {
						c.requestDeferredCompleted()
						console.warn("herdRespond: input deferred-work requested")
						return true
					} catch (e) {
						console.warn("herdRespond: input deferred-work unavailable")
						return false
					}
				}
				Text {
					id: herdLabel
					anchors.centerIn: parent
					width: parent.width - 56
					wrapMode: Text.WordWrap
					horizontalAlignment: Text.AlignHCenter
					font.pointSize: 18
					font.bold: true
					color: herdButton.herdMine && navigator.herdState !== "failed" ? "black" : "white"
					text: herdButton.herdStatusLabel()
				}
				MouseArea {
					anchors.fill: parent
					enabled: !herdButton.herdMine || navigator.herdState === "failed"
					onClicked: {

							herdButton.herdIncompleteDismissed = navigator.herdJob && navigator.herdJob.request ? navigator.herdJob.request : ""
							herdButton.herdIncompletePage = navigator.herdJob && navigator.herdJob.page ? navigator.herdJob.page : ""

					if (!spec || (spec.story_version !== undefined && !story) || !spec.doc || !spec.parent || typeof spec.pages !== "number" || spec.pages % 1 !== 0 || spec.pages < 1 || spec.pages > (story ? 12 : 19) || !reply.request ||
						typeof DocumentImporter.importFromUrls !== "function" || !Library.entryAdded) throw new Error("Native lesson importer unavailable")
